name: 44212-manyimage-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, bounded at 384 requests, safety_seconds 2700.
workload: single-turn, 200 distinct 56x56 images and ~48 tokens of instruction per request: ~1248 prompt tokens in, 2000 out with ignore_eos; 64 concurrent streams over 384 requests.
purpose: A visual catalogue assistant describing 200 thumbnail images per request, 64 concurrent streams with long answers on one GPU.
launch:
# HAZARD -- `limit-mm-per-prompt` must stay on ONE line. The config reader is flat and skips every
# line beginning with a space, so a block-form dict never reaches the engine and the limit would
# silently sit at its default. A value starting `{` is parsed as JSON, which is the form that
# survives.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 200}
max-num-seqs: 64
max-model-len: 8192
tensor-parallel-size: 1
